name: XFP Networkable repeater panel, 16 zones
subtitle: Code/keyswitch entry, c/w psu and network repeater card, metal enclosure
legacyName: XFP Networkable repeater panel, 16 zones, code/keyswitch entry, c/w psu and network repeater card, metal enclosure-
family: Analogue Addressable XFP Networkable Fire Panels
summary: Can be used to repeat the functions of the Context Plus single loop sixteen zone economy XFP Main panel model XFP501E/X/CON at remote parts of a site (e.g. all potential fire service entrances).
description: Offers all of the functions and controls of an XFP501E/X/CON Main panel (access levels 1, 2 and 3).
Requires its own dedicated Mains power and battery back-up supply.
A maximum of eight XFP510-16/CON Repeaters can be connected to one non-networked XFP501E/X/CON Main panel.

Communication between the XFP501E/X/CON Main panel and Repeater XFP510-16/CON requires a CFP761 network driver card (fitted as standard in all XFP510-16/CON repeaters, available as an optional extra on Main XFP501E/X/CON 16 Zone panels).
Repeater network wired in 1.5 mm2 two-core screened fire resistant cable. Network length must not exceed 500 metres.
